description: We are SIGMA, a team passionate about space exploration, technology and innovation. Our project, LUNA – Lunar Survival Simulator, is a low-poly 3D game where players manage oxygen, water and energy while surviving on the Moon. We welcome creative thinkers, programmers, 3D designers and space enthusiasts who enjoy teamwork, problem-solving and learning new skills. Together, we aim to turn an exciting idea into a playable experience!
